Kei Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company's New High Tension (HT) Power Cable Project at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan has started Commercial Operation. The Company's entry into HT power Cable is estimated to contribute strong revenue growth amounting to approx. Rs. 200 Crores in FY 07. The New Plant have capacity of 3000km/pa. HT Cable would fill an important gap in the company's product portfolio. The new product would open up a new market opportunities which is as large as the existing LT Cable resulting in top-line growth. Also, there is a manufacturing flexibility to switch between LT & HT Cables, hence will reduce the risk of the production line running idle. The Plant for HT Cables is situated adjacent to the existing plant for LT Cables at Bhiwadi (Rajasthan) which is well equipped with all infrastructure facilities.
